candidates.title: Telangana government to review RTC-Metro common pass fares after complaints
candidates.excerpt: The Telangana government will review RTC-Metro common pass fares following complaints from commuters. The daily pass costs Rs. 400, while the monthly pass is priced at Rs. 8,500. Transport Minister Ponnam Prabhakar said a meeting with officials would be held soon.
